$comment: Named achievements. `when` is a list of [field, operator, value] tests, all of which must hold. Fields come from the context titles.js assembles; operators are >=, >, <=, <, ==, !=, in. Every title should name a SPECIFIC ACT rather than a grinding threshold — 'beat the camp at orb seven' is a story, 'play 200 valleys' is a chore with a badge taped to it.

titles.name: In Order
titles.hint: Gather all seven in order, 1 to 7.

titles.name: Fleet
titles.hint: Finish a valley in under eight minutes.

titles.name: The Unhurried
titles.hint: Take more than twenty-five minutes over one valley.

titles.name: Untouched
titles.hint: Finish a valley without losing a duel.

titles.name: Fast Hands
titles.hint: Reach seven taps a second in a duel.

titles.name: Blur
titles.hint: Reach nine taps a second in a duel.

titles.name: Camp Breaker
titles.hint: Beat the camp beside orb seven.

titles.name: The Collector
titles.hint: Own every item in the trader's cart.

titles.name: Keeper's Own
titles.hint: Reach the top of the ladder.
